body.content: Candidate 3 (ill-posedness) is the weakest but most criticizable. 'Three consecutive integers that are all even' is mathematically impossible (consecutive integers alternate parity), so reading (b) is not a live alternative — it is a contradiction. The candidate is a strawman. But it is worth keeping as a criticizable foil because it tests whether the neighbourhood treats 'consecutive even integers' as a stipulated compound term or a literal description.
body.why_keep_this: Exposes the semantic presupposition that all neighbourhood artifacts share.
